$comment: Integration config schema for the integrations.zigbee section (Doc 08 §9). Shipped at M9.3; the SchemaRegistry.registerIntegrationSchema call site lands with the adapter factory at M9.4 (W10 boundary). All options default sensibly: the adapter runs correctly with zero configuration (INV-CE-02).

serial_port.description: Serial port path. Auto-detected if omitted.

baud_rate.description: Baud rate. Auto-detected based on coordinator type.

adapter_type.description: Coordinator adapter type. Auto-detected if omitted; set explicitly only if auto-detection fails.

channel.description: Network channel. Auto-selected via energy scan on first run; channels 11/15/20 preferred, 21-26 fallback-only (Aqara/Xiaomi incompatibilities).

permit_join_duration.description: Permit join default duration in seconds (Zigbee spec maximum 254).

adopt_devices.description: IEEE addresses the user accepts for adoption ('0x' + 16 hex chars, the log's own rendering). A listed device adopts when a fresh proposal completes its interview; absent or empty, proposals wait and nothing adopts. Malformed entries are skipped with a warning.

mains_timeout_minutes.description: Active ping after this many minutes of silence (mains-powered devices).

battery_timeout_hours.description: Passive offline timeout for battery-powered sleepy devices.

topology_scan_interval_hours.description: Periodic topology scan interval; 0 disables periodic scans.

reporting_overrides.description: Per-cluster reporting configuration overrides, keyed by hex cluster id string (e.g. "0x0402").

profiles_path.description: Path to the user device-profiles JSON (merged over bundled profiles; user profiles take precedence).

telemetry_threshold_seconds.description: Entities reporting faster than this use TelemetryWriter instead of domain events (Event Model §3.5).

failure_threshold.description: Consecutive command failures before UNREACHABLE status.

max_failures_before_offline.description: Consecutive failures before availability transitions to UNAVAILABLE.

weak_link_threshold_pct.description: Percentage of child routes failing before a router is flagged as a weak link.

health_degraded_device_count.description: Number of unreachable devices before adapter health degrades.

ezsp_config.description: EZSP coordinator configuration overrides (advanced, EZSP only). Rejected values log zigbee.ezsp_config_rejected and fall back to coordinator defaults.
